# confluent_switchover_pairs Data Source

[![Preview](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lifecycle%20Stage-Preview-%2300afba)](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/api.html#section/Versioning/API-Lifecycle-Policy)

!> **Warning:** Switchover is a preview feature. Preview features are introduced to gather customer feedback and may change based on that feedback. They are intended for evaluation and non-production use only, and are not covered by Confluent SLAs. Preview features may be discontinued at any time.

`confluent_switchover_pairs` lists every switchover pair in an environment. Use it to discover pairs without knowing their IDs — for example, to find the pair for a given cluster before triggering a `confluent_switchover_pair_failover` from a workspace that did not create it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "confluent" {
  cloud_api_key    = var.confluent_cloud_api_key    # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_KEY env var
  cloud_api_secret = var.confluent_cloud_api_secret # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET env var
}

data "confluent_switchover_pairs" "all" {
  environment_crn = "crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123"
}

# The pair whose members include a given Kafka cluster.
locals {
  prod_pair = one([
    for pair in data.confluent_switchover_pairs.all.switchover_pairs : pair
    if contains([for m in pair.members : m.member_crn], "crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123/cloud-cluster=lkc-west01")
  ])
}

output "prod_pair_id" {
  value = local.prod_pair.id
}

output "pairs_currently_failed_over" {
  value = [for p in data.confluent_switchover_pairs.all.switchover_pairs : p.id if p.active_member != p.first_active]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `environment_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the environment whose switchover pairs to list, for example, `crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the preceding arguments, the following attributes are exported:

- `switchover_pairs` - (Required List of Object) The switchover pairs in the environment. Each object exports the same attributes as the `confluent_switchover_pair` data source:
  - `id` - (Required String) The ID of the switchover pair, for example, `sw-abc123`.
  - `display_name` - (Required String) A human-readable name for the switchover pair.
  - `environment_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the environment that owns the pair.
  - `members` - (Required List of Object) The two clusters participating in the pair. Each member exports `name`, `member_crn`, `cloud`, and `region`.
  - `active_member` - (Required String) The name of the member that is currently active.
  - `first_active` - (Required String) The name of the member that was active when the pair was first created. Differs from `active_member` while the pair is failed over.
  - `failover_type` - (Required String) The failover semantics most recently applied (`PLANNED`, `UNPLANNED`, or `RESTORE`); empty until a failover has been triggered.
  - `phase` - (Required String) The lifecycle phase of the switchover pair, for example, `READY_TO_FAILOVER`.
